why: Estimated numbers per module for small (frigate / destroyer) combat fits, used by combatcheck.py to find the cheapest fit that passes the 99% rule. Turret dps is with ordinary ammo and no skills; the check scales it by your measured DPS. cap = GJ per second the module uses while running; recharge_mult multiplies the capacitor recharge time (lower is faster). Replace a guess with what the fitting window shows. Hull cap numbers include your skills (read from the fitting window). Blaster/railgun cap values are still guesses: correct them from the fitting window's capacitor delta after fitting.

Catalyst.seen: fitting window 2026-10-28: 560 GJ / 4m57s, delta -12.4 GJ/s (-262.4%) with 8 Civilian Gatling + afterburner, depletes in 35 s
